svg.title: DataSource V2 -- Explicit V2 BatchScanExec & BatchWrite (Iceberg/Delta)
svg.desc: Explicit V2 TableProvider (Iceberg/Delta), optional canCommit, DataWriter -> WriterCommitMessage, and connector BatchWrite.commit(). 1. SQL Planner to Driver DSv2: Plan BatchScan + V2Write (driver-1 in-JVM); 2. Driver DSv2 to DAGScheduler: planInputPartitions + Factory (driver-1 in-JVM); 3. DAGScheduler to Task (Exec 2): LaunchTask(V2 Factories) (driver-1:41000); 4. Task (Exec 2) to DataSource V2: PartitionReader & DataWriter (worker-b in-JVM); 5. DataSource V2 to HDFS DataNode: Write V2 data file (dn01:9866); 6. Task (Exec 2) to OutputCommitCoord: canCommit? (optional) (driver-1:41000); 7. DataSource V2 to Driver DSv2: WriterCommitMessage (driver-1:41000); 8. Driver DSv2 to Driver DSv2: BatchWrite.commit(msgs) (driver-1 in-JVM)
